curve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specific shape proper to the clusters identified by the algorithm, which is characterised by a trend (flat/increasing/decreasing) and, in the latter two cases, by an acceleration or deceleration point (none or premature, median, overdue acceleration/deceleration).

Bibliometric data that includes categories describing the research career of people. Each of such categories is characterised by four specific dimensions: the research period considered, the curve of the chosen citation distribution, the slope of such curve, and the order of magnitude of the citation of such research period.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: research career category
